content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Jennifer Martin (E033)
Request: admin access to Payroll

Facts from notes:
- Role: Analyst (HR says looked up in own database; Security says not looked up, same value as HR)
- Employment type: contractor (both looked up)
- Security training: basic (Security looked up)
- Recommendations: read

Access policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if employee's role owns the system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

Jennifer is a contractor with basic security training. So maximum is read (no advanced training). Requested admin exceeds this, so grant maximum = read.

The system: Payroll is owned by Payroll Specialist role. Jennifer is an Analyst, contractor anyway.

So the decision is read.

Let me submit.
